intro: Between April and July 2026, ZCyberNews published 56 articles on ransomware, tracking LockBit, The Gentlemen, and ShinyHunters as the top threat actors. The coverage spanned 40 high-severity and six critical incidents, with key vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-1731, CVE-2026-34197, CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. Affected sectors ranged across healthcare, government, manufacturing, and education, while targeted regions included North America, the United States, Europe, and Turkey.
